L40: # Save Time and Money with College-Level Courses from Sophia
L41: ## Take courses that transfer to UMass Global for just $99/month
L42: UMass Global (formerly Brandman University) has served working students since 1958 and is continuing that commitment by working with Sophia to provide more flexible opportunities for you to earn college credit.
L43: Sophia's affordable, self-paced courses give you additional options to complete your degree program while balancing work, life, education. Learn anytime, anywhere on your computer tablet or smartphone in an online environment that fits your needs.
L44: Interested in pursuing your business degree?
L45: Knock out college-level courses required by many business programs with Sophia. Our business pathway courses are designed to transfer to your university.
L46: Be sure to check with your Advisor before enrolling to confirm it fits your degree plan.

L94: ### Try Sophia for Free
L95: 
L96: Get started with a free trial and experience Sophia's smart, user-friendly courseroom. Sample as many of our college-level online courses as you'd like, get to know the instructors, and see if Sophia is right for you.

L120: 
L121: Take one or many of our highly-rated courses. Complete all the required assessments with an overall score of 70% or above and go onto the next one.

L125:   * Courses are pass-fail
